text: Yes, tree-cover loss has been detected on the property after 2020. In 2025, a loss event covering 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset) was observed. The data was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference, which confirmed that 98% of the event area was forested in 2020. No prior loss was detected in the 2024 data. The asset had 227.1 hectares of forest cover in 2020 (65.71% of the total area).
